correctness.rationale: For Delta_t,Delta_(t-1)>0, the source min-gap ratio is |q-1|/min(q,1), which equals q-1 for q>=1 and 1/q-1 for q<=1. Thus reciprocal symmetry is exact. For a geometric gap trace the clipped input is constant; solving the source affine EMA with tilde_d_1=1 gives hat_d+(1-hat_d)beta3^(t-1). For c>1 and beta3 in [0,1), hat_d in [1/c,c] is positive and alpha_t converges to alpha1/hat_d. Threshold inequalities yield the stated closed bands, intermediate formula and endpoints. At c=10, q=0.1 and 10 both give d=9, not the upper clamp. Independently reconstructed exact rational tests covered c=2,10,13/2 and eight boundary/interior ratios each. The universal proof is algebraic; checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The central equality is the defining 2016 Eve response rewritten using q=Delta_t/Delta_(t-1). More decisively, its claimed symmetry under q->1/q is exactly the exchange symmetry already built into the source Eq. (8): absolute difference and min of the two positive gaps are each invariant under exchange. The source provides the full response on arbitrary (not merely geometric) positive gap sequences, plus clipping and the EMA recurrence. The geometric phase thresholds are obtained immediately by substituting a constant ratio and solving inequalities; the EMA limit is the standard solution of the same source linear recurrence. Absence of a printed q-notation corollary is not a novelty distinction under the statement-and-implication standard.
residual_risks: The full author-hosted source is the decisive exact general definition. Its discussion does not explicitly print q->1/q as a standalone equation; coverage judgment rests on strict equation equivalence, not matching wording.
Implementations and later descriptions may change the denominator or add epsilon, so the audited equalities apply only to the exact paper definition with strictly positive gaps.
The feedback-channel symmetry alone says nothing about actual Adam-plus-Eve optimization trajectories or practical harm.
